draft.emotion: warm and familiar, speaking of someone close
notes: The dual is أَخَوَانِ (akhawān) and the plural is إِخْوَة (ikhwah, usually for blood brothers) or إِخْوَان (ikhwān, also for friends or fellow members).
One of the 'five nouns' (الأَسْمَاء الخَمْسَة): when followed by a noun or suffix (except 'my'), it takes a long vowel for case: أَخُوكَ (your brother).
